name: Orange Delicious
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¼ cup shredded candied orange peel

steps: Boil sugar and water eight minutes, then add orange juice.
Scald cream, add yolks of eggs, and cook over hot water until mixture thickens.
Cool, add to first mixture with heavy cream beaten stiff.
Freeze; when nearly frozen, add orange peel.
Line a melon mould with Orange Ice, fill with Orange Delicious, pack in salt and ice, and let stand one and one-half hours.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
